adjudication_history.rationale: Uncomplicated discoid morphology is not a diagnosed tear, but the frozen abnormal-morphology clause does not establish variant handling. Withdraw automatic variant-negative inference and preserve masking for protocol-specific adjudication.

adjudication_history.rationale: No free osteochondral fragment is a limited osseous-fragment exclusion after dislocation; it cannot exclude an attached cortical fracture. Retain informative partial-scope uncertainty rather than missing.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Medial meniscus: no definite tear.
adjudication_history.rationale: No definite tear without a corroborating normal-morphology/internal-degeneration assessment is qualified exclusion, not firm absence; initial negative withdrawn.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Lateral meniscus: no definite tear.
adjudication_history.rationale: Same isolated no-definite-tear qualifier leaves equivocal lateral tear possible; initial negative withdrawn.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity and fissuring along the medial femoral condyle near the intercondylar notch. No focal full-thickness defect.
adjudication_history.rationale: No full-thickness defect does not exclude >50% partial loss, and broad mild-chondrosis impression does not specify fissure depth or area. Retain preread uncertainty; reader negative is unsupported by a numeric or superficial-depth statement.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Keine menisceale Rissbildung bei geringen Signalanhebungen des Innenmeniskus in Pars intermedia (5/22).
adjudication_history.rationale: Neither initial missing nor reader negative fully captures scope: generic no-meniscal-tear wording is embedded in a specifically medial-meniscus clause. Whether lateral meniscus is included is unresolved; final uncertain records that localization ambiguity.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis with signal alteration in the medial patellar facet
adjudication_history.rationale: Mild chondrosis with cartilage signal change lacks explicit maintained thickness, superficial morphology or numeric depth; preserve unknown loss criterion rather than infer below threshold.

adjudication_history.source_quote: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage edema on the lateral patellar facet.
adjudication_history.rationale: Cartilage edema/minimal chondrosis describes signal rather than preserved depth. No explicit absent defect or <50% loss evidence; preserve uncertainty and flag signal-only mapping.

adjudication_history.rationale: Millimetric full-depth focal defect lacks exact dimensional bound or high-grade area. Do not automatically equate qualitative millimetric with a maximum extent below roughly1cm; reader negative preserved for size QA.

adjudication_history.rationale: Depressed medial articular surface is an informative but incomplete joint-surface assessment; it does not prove qualifying cartilage loss or normal cartilage. Retain uncertain rather than no target-relevant information.

Meniscal subluxation/degeneration and uncomplicated discoid morphology do not provide a resolved application of abnormal-morphology criterion; both masked pending semantic adjudication.
Reviewer broad global marrow normality versus reader qualified-absence uncertainty; reader objection preserved.
Missing-versus-uncertain target scope disputes: cortical/fragment exclusion, medial-context meniscal wording and depressed articular surface. All final contested targets masked.
Both passes use opposing-surface or multifacet denudation as qualitative full-depth regional extent; preserve for global consistency audit.
